**In one line**: Call-tracking vendor CTM announced a native OpenAI Ads integration that reportedly gives ChatGPT ad campaigns the same phone-call attribution long available on search and social.

### Key points
- CTM (CallTrackingMetrics) unveiled a native integration with OpenAI Ads.
- The tie-in reportedly lets advertisers attribute **phone calls** generated by ChatGPT-based ad campaigns, on par with other channels.
- It marks the first time call-conversion tracking — standard in search and social advertising — extends to ChatGPT ads.

### Why it matters
For industries where a phone call is the real conversion — healthcare, legal, home services — call attribution is a core performance metric. ChatGPT ads gaining this capability signals that OpenAI's ad products are moving toward measurement parity with established search and social platforms.
